digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler / Data Center backend unit tests
propositions: Data Center backend has no value-pinning characterization suite; existing Cloud suite hard-binds to JiraBackend and does not cover DC implementations

DC's _map_local_to_dc_fields mapper and sanitizer boundaries must be pinned by exact value for every key (summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee, label) including default-fallback branches and truncation behavior

The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote must be exercised through WikiTextCodec to pin that description fit-to-limit, non-str passthrough, and status/priority mapping work correctly on the DC path
DC probe classification must be pinned against all four branches (PRESENT_RESOLVED, PRESENT_FILTERED, ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, UNREACHABLE) using the real classifier, not FakeTransport's stub
DC probe classification must bind its own resolved_statuses config, demonstrable by passing a non-default set that differs from Cloud's hardcoded RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES
DC identity label form must be pinned by exact value including the colon-delimiter canonical prefix
